bottlenecks_identified: RETRO-MANIFEST-FULL-SCOPE (CRITICAL, SEVENTH CONSECUTIVE): manifest_fix_patch.txt exists in repo since .56 but has not been applied to conductor dispatch site in seven consecutive milestones. Exps 786, 527, 491, 627 collectively ran 224 min this milestone with zero research value. Cumulative preventable waste .60-.65: ~1,344 min (22.4 hours). This is the single largest recoverable bottleneck in project history.

DOCUMENTATION-WITHOUT-APPLICATION LOOP (SEVENTH CONSECUTIVE): Every retro from .59 through .65 documented the same seven improvement actions. Zero have been applied before the next milestone begins. The loop is structural: retro findings go into a document that is read in the planning session but not acted upon before execution resumes.

RETRO-SOTA-MODEL-DOWNLOAD: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF-Q4_K_M.gguf not present on disk. Exp 850 blocked at model load — code repair experiment produced zero output for 9th consecutive milestone. GGUFCacheResolver now exists (Exp 849) but the model file itself is absent. This is an operator pre-flight gap.

RETRO-LIVE-ENV-NOT-PROPAGATED: Exp 853 returned inference_mode='cpu_mock' because CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE env var was not propagated. The env_autofix heuristic ran but overwrote rather than set the variable. Recurrence of RETRO-015 pattern via a new code path. Four consecutive milestones of live benchmark attempts blocked by same env var.

SEQUENTIAL GPU EXECUTION: Both RTX 3090s at 0% utilization at close. DualGPURunner (validated at 1.96x throughput, Exp 685) never deployed in production path. GPU-bound experiments (Exp 786-type) run sequentially despite two idle GPUs. Estimated ~60 min/milestone opportunity cost.

SVAMP ARCHITECTURE LIMITATION (CASCADING BLOCKER): Exp 844 applied 8x PRM weight boost — largest domain weight in project history — and still produced auc_svamp=0.0. JEPA deployment remains blocked (Exp 845). Two milestones of data reweighting with zero AUC movement indicates model has no representational capacity for SVAMP error patterns, not a data coverage gap.

ICE40 VERILOG REGISTER EXPANSION: Exp 851 N=16 consumed 12,258 LCs (159% of HX8K budget) because lf_comb memory array expanded to individual flip-flops at P&R rather than block RAM. Synthesis reported 2 LUTs; P&R exploded to 12,258. KV260 board has been idle since 2026-04-20 (5 milestones). The root cause is diagnosed but not fixed.

EXPERIMENT COUNT GOVERNANCE: 772 experiments vs 700 cap — exceeded by 72 experiments, highest overage in project history. Each experiment above cap adds ~5 min wall time. 72 over cap = ~360 min of structural overhead from scope creep.

improvements_suggested.action: Fix SVAMP architecture: add domain-specific linear head on top of base JEPA embeddings for word-problem arithmetic domain. PRM reweighting has been tried with 1x, 4x, and 8x boost — all produce auc_svamp=0.0. Reweighting cannot teach the base model features it has not learned. Domain-specific head with residual connection is the minimum architectural change needed.

improvements_suggested.action: Fix iCE40 Verilog to use SB_RAM40_4K block RAM primitives for J and h storage instead of lf_comb register arrays. Alternatively, reduce N from 16 to 8 as a proof-of-concept (estimated ~600 LUTs, well within HX8K 7680 LC budget). The root cause (register expansion at P&R) is diagnosed; architectural fix is straightforward.

Deploy DualGPURunner for GPU-bound experiments: assign Qwen to GPU 0 and Gemma to GPU 1 using ThreadPoolExecutor pattern validated in Exp 685 (1.96x speedup). Both RTX 3090s are idle at milestone close — sequential execution wastes ~50% of available GPU throughput on every multi-model experiment.
